aboutParagraphs: Used since Antiquity for decorative purposes, ceramic tile has always been the essential artistic element for adorning the residences of the upper class and the most sumptuous buildings. Today, the industry has reduced tiling to a smooth and monotonous product limited to four imitations: marble, wood, stone and cement.

Arcada has come to restore ceramic tile to its rightful artistic place in the world of decoration, giving its clients the possibility of creating unique spaces that meet the most demanding requirements. This is achieved through the incorporation of geometric shapes displayed in relief, with multiple applications, colors, special decorative effects and shades, the use of high-quality raw materials and state-of-the-art equipment.
Our collections integrate perfectly into architectural elements and interior decoration, are durable, unalterable and require no maintenance.
We invite you to visit our showroom in Sebala (Draria) to discover our collections up close. We guarantee excellent service and irreproachable quality.
